programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Ordinary girl Bao meets troubled rich guy Edward. They conspire to ruin his father's remarriage and love blossoms. However, their romance takes an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Headed by elite pilots, a special operations team is tasked to test new fighter jets. During test flights, the pilots face different difficulties and challenges, and try to push beyond their limits.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Player
programme.desc: When two notorious \"players\.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: I'm Livin' it
programme.desc: Once a successful banker, Bowen now spends his nights in a 24-hour fast food joint with a group of homeless people, with a plan to get themselves out of rock bottom.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan research news from across a popular BBS forum. Xiang, a forum founder, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas but being the subject of heated debate due to a leaked video.

programme.title: My Wife Is A Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: Gambling queen, Ying Ying who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition and rescued by Gerrard but suffering from amnesia, she decided recover in time to compete in the big event!

programme.title: My Kung Fu Sweetheart
programme.desc: Phoenix's parents are secret martial arts heroes ferreting out evildoers. Phoenix gets the chance to train in the misty mountains, where she learns of her all-important romantic destiny.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A triad boss aims to clean up his image and win Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change, but struggles with funding issues. As his enforcers resort to violence, unexpected tensions arise among them.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their father's drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: When a former boxing champ and a rich man's son both enter an MMA competition, they believe they are powerful - until they meet an even more formidable opponent.

programme.title: Fight Back To School II
programme.desc: After demoted to traffic duty, Sing determines to be an undercover again at school to regain his reputation of being a leader of SDU.

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about abuse in a care home for elderly and disabled. Reporter Kay goes undercover to unveil the cruel truth in broad daylight.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of prison corruption to the ICAC. ICAC officer Luk goes undercover in prison to investigate and is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: In order to win her future mother-in-law's approval, Ceci must be crowned in a gourmet cooking competition. However, there's a catch; Ceci is terrible at cooking.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammer's clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story

programme.title: Far Far Away

programme.title: Ip Man 3
